description:
A music player that respects what's yours.

Noctis is a desktop music player for your local library — fast browsing,
synced lyrics, metadata editing, EQ, and more.
Discord
Download
Pick your platform from the Assets below:
────────┬──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Platform│Files
────────┼──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Windows │Noctis-v1.4.0-Setup.exe (installer) · Noctis-windows-x64.zip (portable)
────────┼──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
macOS   │Noctis-osx-arm64.dmg (Apple Silicon) · Noctis-osx-x64.dmg (Intel)
────────┼──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Linux   │Noctis-x86_64.AppImage · Noctis-linux-x64.tar.gz ·
        │Noctis-linux-arm64.tar.gz
────────┴──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
> Running on macOS — the app isn't code-signed, so Gatekeeper quarantines it on first launch. After dragging Noctis into your Applications folder, clear the flag once in Terminal:
>
> xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Noctis.app
>
> Then open Noctis normally.
What's Changed
Fixed
- Fixed now-playing track row rendered as blank white bar
- Fixed album and playlist description dialogs blank in light mode
- Fixed Jellyfin "Couldn't reach the server" on bare addresses
Added
- Added BETA badges for Liquid Glass and Song Transitions
- Added dedicated Close/Clear row in Queue popup
- Added frosted buttons for Liquid Glass mode
Improved
- Improved Music Server form layout (fixed width, better scrolling)
- Improved server section header label
- Improved empty-library message wording and positioning
- Improved server type switching (clears form on change)
Full Changelog: v1.3.9...v1.4.0
